claim: By default, URL query strings, HTTP headers and cookies from the viewer request are not included in the origin request; the exception is legacy cache settings, with which CloudFront forwards the headers to the origin by default.

evidence.quote: Other information from the viewer request, such as URL query strings, HTTP headers, and cookies, is not included in the origin request by default.
(Exception: With legacy cache settings, CloudFront forwards the headers to your origin by default.)

qualifiers.condition: except with legacy cache settings, which forward headers by default
